> **`v0.7.2` was never published to PyPI and is not a usable release.** The tag points at commit `2d7339f`, whose source still declares version `0.6.0`, on a side branch that is not part of `main`'s history; GitHub's [`v0.7.1...v0.7.2`](https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-validation-python/compare/v0.7.1...v0.7.2) comparison reports it as diverged (2 commits ahead, 44 behind), so the *Full Changelog* link below shows that side branch rather than release changes. The `Publish to PyPI` run for this tag failed, so no `0.7.2` package exists: install `0.7.1` or `0.7.3`. The tag is kept unchanged as an audit record; see [Release history and provenance](https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-validation-python/blob/main/docs/release_history.md#v072-invalid-tag-never-published).

> **`v0.9.0` was not published to PyPI.** Its `Publish to PyPI` run failed at the "Build distribution packages" step (the job log has expired), so no `0.9.0` package exists. `0.9.1`, published about 15 minutes later, includes every change listed here. The tag is kept unchanged as an audit record; see [Release history and provenance](https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-validation-python/blob/main/docs/release_history.md#v090-unpublished-superseded-by-v091).

> **`v0.17.0` was not published to PyPI.** The release candidate passed its build, library tests, host checks and real-Azure certification, but all four runtime-audit jobs then failed in their guard-test step: pytest could not load the project's `tests/conftest.py` in an interpreter without `azure-functions` (`ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'azure'`), so the publish job was skipped. The latest version on PyPI is `0.16.0`. The cause is fixed on `main` ([#625](https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-validation-python/pull/625)); the changes below, including the required `ValidationAdapter.serialize_response()` migration, will reach PyPI with the first published release after `0.16.0`. The tag is kept unchanged as an audit record; see [Release history and provenance](https://github.com/yeongseon/azure-functions-validation-python/blob/main/docs/release_history.md#v0170-unpublished-release-candidate).
